Hi Olivia,

Thank you for the conversation at the SEO Career Summit in New York.

My name is Maya Okafor, and I'm a sophomore at Duke University, graduating in May 2029. I'm writing to a fellow Duke alum who also calls Atlanta home.

I'm studying economics, and the part of finance that draws me most is consumer and retail M&A. This summer I interned at Pinecrest Wealth Partners in Atlanta, where I built a screening model for 40 dividend stocks, and I'm a consumer sector analyst in the Duke Investment Club.

I had two questions about Morrow & Pike. First, when does the sophomore program open? Second, does it feed into the summer analyst class?

My resume is attached. Thank you very much for your time!

Best,
Maya Okafor
Duke University ’29

(919) 555-0142
